title: Odd one out
info: The odd one out does not follow the same rule as the others.
Name the rule first: all animals, all even numbers, all closed shapes.

questions.q: Which does not belong: cat, dog, bus, horse?
Which does not belong: red, blue, seven, green?
Which does not belong: triangle, square, circle, banana?
Odd one out: 3, 6, 9, 10. Type the number.
Which does not belong: penny, nickel, apple, dime?
